Screen Printing for Cañon City's Royal Gorge Community

Cañon City is Fremont County's largest city — about 17,000 residents and the gateway to the Royal Gorge, one of Colorado's most visited natural attractions. The local economy runs on three pillars: tourism anchored by the Royal Gorge Bridge and Royal Gorge Route Railroad; healthcare; and the corrections industry — the Colorado Department of Corrections has multiple facilities in the area, making it one of the city's largest employers. Custom apparel for tourism operators, healthcare workers, corrections staff, and local businesses serving this diverse economy all find a home at ARK.

Cañon City High School Tigers are the city's main athletic program, competing in the Fremont RE-1 School District. Canon City also has a notable community identity — the annual Blossom Festival is one of the region's longest-running community events. We're about 45 miles northeast in Colorado Springs and ship directly to Cañon City with reliable turnaround times.

Royal Gorge tourism

Branded apparel for Royal Gorge tour operators, rafting companies, and the area's visitor economy.

Cañon City Tigers

Spirit wear and team uniforms for Fremont RE-1 school athletics.

Healthcare & corrections

Custom workwear for Cañon City's major employers in corrections, healthcare, and county government.
